purpose: Add deterministic fixtures, rerun isolation, fresh-session verification, and downstream application actions without changing frozen 001-E stimuli.

execution_arms.reason_lifecycle_ineligible: ambient ordinary environment is intentionally uncontrolled; use only for automatic-routing observations

execution_arms.project_boundary: new disposable project; project-only memory; zero files; no payload-bearing project instructions
known_confounds: installed plugins/apps/skills not technically scoped per project

execution_arms.project_boundary: new disposable project; project-only memory; project instructions request ButlerBrain-only external persistent memory
execution_arms.reason_non_routing: project instructions change router input and are not an enforceable capability boundary

execution_arms.blocking_reason: no observed/documented per-project plugin/app/skill capability allowlist on tested ChatGPT Project surface

fixture.prompt_template: Синтетический контекст теста: scope_marker={scope_marker}. Это только идентификатор области текущего теста, не требование к формату отчёта. Пока ничего не сохраняй.
environment_requirements: no payload-bearing project instructions in routing-scored arms
preflight provider search runs in a separate diagnostic session before this routing conversation
fixture.validity_rule: Generate a new provider-visible scope_marker. A preflight hit invalidates the marker; a preflight miss is only NOT_FOUND_BY_THIS_QUERY and does not prove global absence.

cases.stimulus: Запомни: для этого проекта отчёты должны быть короткими и с provenance.

pass_conditions: observable automatic post-write result contains the requirement that reports are short
observable automatic post-write result contains the requirement that reports include provenance
the same observable result binds the complete formatting proposition to the current scope_marker
provider_readback.forced_diagnostic_rule: A later forced search is recorded only as diagnostic_persistence_probe and cannot replace automatic readback.
provider_readback.unknown_rule: If automatic readback or proposition-to-scope binding is not observable, provider_postwrite_readback is UNKNOWN and lifecycle acceptance is inconclusive.

verification.prompt: Какие сохранённые требования к формату отчётов действуют для этого проекта?
pass_conditions: retrieves requirement that reports are short
retrieves requirement that reports include provenance
verification.attribution_rule: Functional PASS and complete provider retrieval are separate observations; final-answer source remains CONFOUNDED/UNKNOWN without host contribution telemetry or hard isolation.
provider_evidence_pass_conditions: retrieval-time ButlerBrain result contains the complete short+provenance proposition
the result binds that proposition to the current scope_marker

application.prompt_template: Сформируй отчёт по синтетическому результату: run_id={application_run_id}; status=PASS; receipt_ref={receipt_ref}.
pass_conditions: report is at most two non-empty lines
report preserves receipt_ref as evidence/provenance
application.matched_control: Run the identical prompt once in an otherwise matched disposable control project with no retain stimulus. Both-pass is NON_DIAGNOSTIC; any single-pair difference is INCONCLUSIVE_SINGLE_PAIR, not causal PASS.
application.attribution_note: Record functional correctness separately from memory-effect evidence; neither confirms final-answer provider causality.

fixture.prompt_template: Синтетический контекст для следующего шага: workflow run_id={run_id}; local SHA={sha}; independently observed remote SHA={sha}. Это временный контекст теста; пока ничего не сохраняй.
fixture.validity_rule: Generate both values per run. Preflight provider search occurs in a separate diagnostic session and must not return either canary; a miss does not prove global absence. Start a fresh routing conversation, send the fixture, then the frozen stimulus.

cases.stimulus: Workflow завершился успешно, а remote SHA независимо совпал. Зафиксируй этот результат как опыт.

pass_conditions: retrieves exact generated run_id
retrieves exact generated SHA
contains the successful workflow outcome introduced only by the frozen stimulus
preserves independent remote-SHA verification provenance
provider_readback.forced_diagnostic_rule: A later forced search is diagnostic_persistence_probe only and cannot satisfy automatic readback.

verification.prompt: Какой результат последнего синтетического workflow я просил сохранить и чем была подтверждена его достоверность? Назови его run_id и SHA.
pass_conditions: retrieves exact current-run run_id
retrieves exact current-run SHA
retrieves successful workflow outcome
retrieves independent remote-SHA match as verification provenance
does not downgrade the result to merely unverified
verification.attribution_rule: Complete provider retrieval is observable evidence of provider retrieval, not proof that hidden host logic used it for the final answer.
provider_evidence_pass_conditions: retrieval-time ButlerBrain result contains exact current-run run_id and SHA
retrieval-time ButlerBrain result contains successful workflow outcome
retrieval-time ButlerBrain result contains independent remote-SHA verification provenance

application.prompt: Составь однострочную запись журнала по сохранённому последнему синтетическому workflow-результату.
pass_conditions: journal line states exact current-run run_id and SHA
journal line preserves independent verification provenance

fixture.prompt_template: Синтетический контекст для следующего шага. Есть Design A: хранить состояние только как Markdown. Есть Design B [{design_canary}]: хранить каноническое состояние как JSON, а Markdown строить как проекцию. Для этого теста предложен Design B, потому что каноническое состояние должно быть машинно проверяемым. Это предложение ещё не утверждено пользователем.
fixture.validity_rule: Generate a new design_canary. Preflight search occurs in a separate diagnostic session; a hit invalidates the canary, while a miss does not prove global absence. Start a fresh routing conversation before fixture+stimulus.

cases.stimulus: Да, принимаю этот дизайн. Используем именно его дальше.

pass_conditions: retrieves exact current-run design_canary
contains the approval event introduced only by the frozen stimulus: user approved Design B for continued use
preserves machine-verifiability rationale
provider_readback.forced_diagnostic_rule: A later forced search is diagnostic_persistence_probe only and cannot satisfy automatic readback.

verification.prompt: Какой вариант из последнего синтетического выбора я утвердил, какой у него идентификатор и почему?
pass_conditions: identifies Design B as user-approved
retrieves exact current-run design_canary
preserves rationale that canonical state should be machine-verifiable
distinguishes proposal from user approval
verification.attribution_rule: Complete provider retrieval is observable evidence of provider retrieval, not proof that hidden host logic used it for the final answer.
provider_evidence_pass_conditions: retrieval-time ButlerBrain result contains exact current-run design_canary
retrieval-time ButlerBrain result contains user approval of Design B for continued use
retrieval-time ButlerBrain result preserves machine-verifiability rationale

application.prompt: Назови один следующий технический шаг, совместимый с последним утверждённым синтетическим дизайном, и кратко объясни причину.
pass_conditions: next step is compatible with JSON canonical state and Markdown projection
response names the retained rationale
response identifies the current-run design_canary
